summary: Map in a corner: the map picture, the current zone (red) and the next one (white), and markers. Zones and global marks are the same for everyone; the map, the player's arrow and personal marks are per player. Positions are a class ladder on a grid; an optional zoom follows the player.

panels.doc: The minimap. Author it `hidden`. `at-tl|tr|bl|br` is MinimapOptions.Placement, `size-sm|md|lg` MinimapOptions.Size (a ui-scale of the 256px map), `style-*` the frame's accent.
The map viewport: `map-<name>` is its picture (MinimapMaps), drawn on the `.minimap-world` panel inside. Clips what goes past its edges.
Everything on the map. `zoom-N` (N of MinimapLayout.Zooms, a percentage) scales it about the viewport's centre; none = the whole map. Markers are scaled back to their size.
Inside mm_zoom: `px-N` moves cell N to the centre (X axis), so a zoom follows the player.
Y axis of the pan, a child of mm_pan.
Label under the map, `empty` when blank.
Current zone, X axis of its centre. `x-N` (N of MinimapLayout.Grid) places it, `dur-N` is the length of a shrink: without one it snaps.
Y axis of the current zone's centre: a child, so each axis has its own transform.
The current zone's circle, centred on its parent: `r-N` scales it, `r-<Radii>` being a radius as wide as the map.
Next zone, same as the current one.
Y axis of the next zone's centre.
A marker, X axis. Author it `hidden`. `kind-<name>` its icon and stacking order (MinimapNames), `state-downed|dead|alerted`, `style-*` a colour over the kind's.
The icon: `rot-N` turns it N*10 degrees clockwise from north (N of 0..35).
Label of the marker, `empty` when blank.
